sections.title: Build Overview
paragraphs: Twister is a sequence build. Ice-Tipped Arrows prepares the cold interaction, Whirling Slash creates the movement or setup line, and Twister converts that preparation into travelling area damage. On bosses, dodge roll and Barrage enter the sequence, so the build should be learned as ordered actions rather than a collection of individually strong gems.

The maintained planner lists non-crit and several crit variants, but those names hide the real gates: enough Spirit for the chosen package, a survivable body armour choice, reliable projectile behavior and a rotation that works without showcase-level gear.
The guide separates a simple mapping loop from the full boss preparation sequence, because weapon sets, dodge timing and empowered projectiles make the complete route materially more complex.
bullets: For mapping, maintain the chosen Twister empowerment and avoid unnecessary setup.
For bosses, prepare the weapon set, empowerment and auxiliary attack before the main Twister window.
Treat advertised DPS as creator-specific until the planner and gameplay conditions reproduce.

sections.title: Mapping
paragraphs: Use Ice-Tipped Arrows, pass through or reposition with Whirling Slash, then cast Twister only when the prepared line can hit meaningful targets. Dodge roll can correct the angle, but repeated rolling is a symptom that the approach path is poor.
For mapping, maintain the chosen Twister empowerment and avoid unnecessary setup.

sections.title: Bossing
paragraphs: Create the Whirling Slash line, roll through the safe angle, apply Ice-Tipped Arrows, use Barrage, then release Twister. Do not judge the build from a Twister cast that skipped the setup or travelled away from the target.
Treat advertised DPS as creator-specific until the planner and gameplay conditions reproduce.

items.question: Why does Twister miss a target standing beside me?
answer: The projectile follows the prepared path and angle; proximity alone is not enough. Rebuild the Whirling Slash line and release Twister into the target's future position.
bullets: Test in open terrain.
Use one roll to correct the angle.
Avoid judging the skill in a doorway.

items.question: Why did the crit version lose survivability or Spirit?
answer: A crit swap often changes several slots. Compare body armour, amulet, belt, charge generation and Spirit reservation together, not just the weapon or passive tree.

items.question: What if I prefer a direct melee path?
answer: Whirling Assault Martial Artist keeps the movement-heavy identity but centers damage on melee contact, bell windows and charge management.
